No. 5, S-2024 Pipeline Legislative pipeline The legislative pipeline under the Local Government Code of 1991. 1 Filing A proposed ordinance is filed with the Sangguniang Bayan for consideration. 2 First Reading Initial reading and referral to the relevant committee for review. 3 Committee Hearing The committee holds hearings and deliberates on the proposal. 4 Committee Report Findings and recommendations are submitted back to the full council. 5 Second Reading Detailed floor discussion and debate on the proposed ordinance. 6 Third & Final Reading Final vote by the Sangguniang Bayan. 7 Mayor's Approval The Municipal Mayor reviews and approves the enacted ordinance. 8 Provincial Review Submitted to the Sangguniang Panlalawigan of Pangasinan for legal review under Sections 56 and 57 of R.A. 7160. 9 Posting & Effect The approved ordinance is posted publicly and takes effect across all 15 constituent barangays. Key Distinction Ordinance vs. Resolution Under the Local Government Code of 1991, the Sangguniang Bayan enacts two types of legislative measures: Ordinance A legislative measure that enacts a permanent rule or policy . Ordinances carry the force of law, create offices, levy taxes, or regulate conduct. They require three readings, publication, and the Mayor's approval (or passage by 2/3 override of a veto). Resolution A legislative measure that expresses the sentiment, intent, or opinion of the Sangguniang Bayan on a specific matter. Resolutions are used for internal housekeeping, requesting national action, or authorizing one-time transactions. They require only one reading and are not subject to publication.

title: Tungkol sa — BetterMapandan.org
description: Tungkol sa Bayan ng Mapandan, Pangasinan, at sa Better Mapandan civic transparency project.
body: About Better Mapandan About Better Mapandan An independent civic transparency portal for the Municipality of Mapandan, Pangasinan. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "AboutPage", "name": "About Better Mapandan", "url": "https://bettermapandan.org/about/", "description": "Better Mapandan is an independent civic transparency portal built and maintained by volunteers. It is part of the BetterGov.ph initiative to create open, accessible civic information websites for Philippine municipalities.", "mainEntity": { "@type": "WebSite", "name": "Better Mapandan", "url": "https://bettermapandan.org" } } About Mapandan Ang bayan Kasaysayan Mapandan was created as an independent pueblo on December 28, 1887, through Director General No. 39. After a period of financial insolvency (1905–1908) when it was re-absorbed into Mangaldan, the town was re-established as an independent municipality in 1909 under Executive Order No. 10 by Governor General James F. Smith. The town was named for the abundance of fragrant pandan plants in the area. Heograpiya Mapandan is a third-class municipality in the province of Pangasinan, Philippines. It covers a land area of 32.92 km² and is composed of 15 barangays. The municipality is located in the western part of Pangasinan, bordered by the Lingayen Gulf to the north and the Agno River floodplain to the south. Population 38,228 PSA Census 2024 Land Area 32.92 km² MPDC Land Use Plan 2024 Barangay 15 DILG / Comelec Cultural Heritage Local traditions and community life Pandan Festival Held annually during the second week of April, the Pandan Festival celebrates Mapandan's cultural heritage with street dancing, pageants, and community gatherings. Pandan Festival Town Plaza The historic center of Mapandan's community life and civic gatherings. Town Plaza Agriculture Rice fields and farmland across Mapandan's countryside — the agricultural heart of the municipality. Agriculture Kasaysayan Ang Mapandan sa paglipas ng mga taon 1887–1909 Pagkakatatag at Maagang Pamamahala From southern barrios of Mangaldan to an independent pueblo—and back again. Mapandan’s first two decades were defined by the courage of its founders, the fragility of a new town, and the determination to rise again. Magbasa pa Before 1887: Southern barrios of Mangaldan Before Mapandan existed as an independent pueblo, the area belonged to Mangaldan. The future municipality consisted of southern communities including Payapay, Baloling, Apaya and Amanoaoac. The movement toward establishing a separate town was initiated by ten local leaders: Antonio Morales, Sabino Prado, Andres Bongato, Ambrosio Calimlim, Valeriano Tamondong, Tomas Aquino, Fulgencio Nato, Filomeno Sarmiento, Jose Lalas, and Florencio Datuin. December 28, 1887: Mapandan becomes a pueblo Mapandan was established as an independent pueblo through Direction General No. 39, Administration Civil No. 169-C, signed by Governor General Emilio Bravo. The new pueblo was initially composed of the southern barrios of Mangaldan: Payapay, Baloling, Apaya and Amanoaoac. The first town center: Torres The first center of the new pueblo was in what is now Barangay Torres. The area had abundant pandan plants and was associated with a church where Fr. Jose Torres served as parish priest. However, the location proved inconvenient—too close to the southern boundary and too far from communities to the north. The center was eventually transferred to an area that had previously been a sitio of Apaya. Much of the land in the new Poblacion was owned by the Aquino family. Leon Hilario Aquino encouraged settlement by subdividing land into uniform lots and making them available to families. 1903: The epidemic An epidemic severely affected Mapandan, causing major population depletion, residents leaving the town, declining municipal resources, and a financial crisis. The 1903 census recorded Mapandan’s population at 4,198. 1905–1908: Return to Mangaldan Because of the population and financial problems caused by the epidemic, Mapandan was temporarily returned to its mother municipality, Mangaldan. 1909: Restoration Mapandan was formally re-established as a municipality under Executive Order No. 10, signed by Governor General James F. Smith. 1910s–1940s Paglago ng Agrikultura at Panahon ng Digmaan After its restoration, Mapandan developed as a predominantly agricultural community. Farming remained central to the local economy, with rice becoming the municipality’s principal crop. The decades ahead would bring war, occupation, and the beginning of reconstruction. Magbasa pa Agricultural foundations Rice became the municipality’s principal crop and livestock raising developed as an important secondary livelihood. The municipality’s current seal still reflects these agricultural foundations through its rice, cattle, chicken and hog imagery. 1940s: War, occupation and rebuilding The Second World War interrupted the development of communities across Pangasinan. In the postwar years, Mapandan’s communities entered a period of reconstruction and social and economic change. The decades following the war also brought changes in landholding, agriculture, education and local community organization. 1940s–1970s Pag-unlad ng Komunidad Pagkatapos ng Digmaan After the war, Mapandan’s communities began to take shape. New barangays were formed, land ownership changed hands, and the municipality entered a period of organized community development. Magbasa pa Barangays begin taking shape Instead of only telling municipal history, the history of how Mapandan’s communities formed tells an equally important story. Sta. Maria — Formerly part of Luyan, developed from former hacienda land. Tenants gained opportunities to own the land they had been farming after the war. It became a separate barrio in 1965. Golden — Formerly Amanoaoac North, a sitio of Amanoaoac. Its name was associated with the Golden Distillery, which operated after liberation. Golden became a separate barangay in 1967. Torres — The first seat of Mapandan, which once contained several sitios that later developed into separate barangays. 1967–1973: Community development Golden was officially approved as a separate barangay in 1967. The community then underwent substantial development including road improvement, waterworks, school construction, sports facilities, cooperative organization, agricultural training, and sanitation programs. 1972 — Golden was recognized as a SEATO/PACD Model Village, receiving a national-level award presented in Malacañang on September 8, 1972. 1972–1973 — Coral became a barangay through Municipal Council Resolution No. 87 (May 4, 1972), Provincial Board Resolution No. 155 (August 10, 1972), and Proclamation No. 11 (April 25, 1973), followed by a special election for barangay officials on May 6, 1973. 1980s–2001 Modernization Mapandan’s population grew substantially, its services expanded, and infrastructure developed. The municipality moved from historical survival toward economic growth. Read more Population growth Mapandan’s population grew steadily through the second half of the 20th century: 20,094 in 1980, 25,622 in 1990, and 30,775 in 2000. Infrastructure and services The municipality expanded roads, schools, health facilities, and public services. Community organizations grew alongside the population. 2002–2024 Pag-unlad sa ika-21 Siglo From a new municipal classification to healthcare expansion and digital government—Mapandan enters the 21st century with growing services, cultural pride, and a more connected community. Read more 2002: A new municipal classification Mapandan was elevated to a third-class municipality. The municipality credits then-Mayor Jose Ferdinand Z. Calimlim Jr. with spearheading income and revenue-generation strategies that contributed to the municipality’s elevation. 2010s: Celebrating the Pandan heritage The Pandan Festival developed into an important annual celebration of Mapandan’s identity, culture and community. The 9th Pandan Festival was held alongside the town fiesta from March 11–19, 2018. 2017–2018: Early digital government efforts The municipal government began developing an online presence that made government information, public notices, disaster information and community announcements accessible through the web. 2022–2024: Expanding healthcare access National health infrastructure funding supported the development of the Mapandan Super Health Center. The 2022 General Appropriations Act included ₱6.5 million for the project. Its first phase was inaugurated on March 15, 2024, expanding access to laboratory, dental and primary healthcare services for residents of Mapandan and nearby communities. 2020s: Government services go digital Mapandan’s government information infrastructure increasingly incorporates digital channels, including information and access guidance for the national eGovPH platform. 2024: Mapandan today More than 130 years after its establishment as a pueblo, Mapandan is a 15-barangay municipality with a population of 38,228. Its history has been shaped by migration, agriculture, community organization, local government, cultural traditions and continuing investment in public services. ← 1 / 5 → Source: Mayor Karl Vega, “History of Mapandan” — YouTube Sources & Historical Notes Historical accounts drawn from municipal archives, provincial records, and published heritage studies of Pangasinan. Municipality of Mapandan — Municipal Profile Municipality of Mapandan — Physical Characteristics Philippine Statistics Authority — Mapandan PSGC Philippine News Agency — Super Health Center Inauguration Paglago ng Populasyon Ang Mapandan sa pamamagitan ng senso Populasyon ayon sa taon ng census Year Population 1903 4,198 1918 6,049 1939 7,286 1948 9,836 1960 13,065 1970 16,653 1980 20,094 1990 25,622 2000 30,775 2010 34,439 2020 38,058 2024 38,228 Source: Philippine Statistics Authority, Census of Population (1903–2024) About the Project Ano ang Better Mapandan? Better Mapandan is an independent civic transparency portal built and maintained by volunteers. It is part of the BetterGov.ph initiative to create open, accessible civic information websites for Philippine municipalities. Aming Misyon To make government information accessible, understandable, and actionable for every Mapandan resident. We believe that open data strengthens democracy and empowers communities to participate meaningfully in local governance. Kung Paano Ito Gumagana We compile publicly available government data — from COA audit reports, PSA census data, municipal disclosures, and provincial issuances — into a single, easy-to-navigate website. Every piece of information is sourced and attributed. Open Source The source code is publicly available. Developers can contribute, audit, and improve the platform. View on GitHub → Independent Ang Better Mapandan ay isang independent na civic transparency portal. Ito ay hindi opisyal na website ng pamahalaan at hindi kaakibat, ineendorso, o pinapatakbo ng Munisipalidad ng Mapandan o ng anumang ahensiya ng pamahalaan. Pinapatakbo ng mga Boluntaryo Built and maintained entirely by volunteers. No government funding is used. Cost to the people of Mapandan: ₱0. Contribute Makilahok Better Mapandan thrives on community participation. Here's how you can help: Iulat ang Maling Impormasyon Spotted an error? Help us keep the data accurate by reporting mistakes. Report an error → Mag-contribute ng Code Developers can contribute features, fix bugs, or improve accessibility on GitHub. Fork on GitHub → I-verify ang Datos Help verify government information by cross-referencing with official sources. Submit verification → Ibahagi sa mga Residente Spread the word about Better Mapandan so more residents can access government information. Disclaimer Mahalagang Paunawa Ang Better Mapandan ay isang independent na civic transparency portal. Ito ay hindi opisyal na website ng pamahalaan at hindi kaakibat, ineendorso, o pinapatakbo ng Munisipalidad ng Mapandan o ng anumang ahensiya ng pamahalaan. Information presented on this site is compiled from publicly available government sources and community research. While we strive for accuracy, we cannot guarantee the completeness or timeliness of all data. For official government information, please visit mapandan.gov.ph or contact the municipal government directly.

title: Better Mapandan — Portal ng Civic Transparency para sa Mapandan, Pangasinan
description: Isang independiyenteng civic transparency portal para sa Mapandan, Pangasinan na nag-aalok ng impormasyon tungkol sa mga opisyal, badyet, ordinansa, frontline services, at emergency contacts, na binuo sa ilalim ng BetterGov.ph BetterLGU initiative.
body: Malaya · Pinapanatili ng Mamamayan · Pangasinan Better Mapandan Isang civic transparency portal para sa Mapandan, Pangasinan Tingnan ang mga Serbisyo Tingnan ang Badyet Maghanap ng Serbisyo Maghanap sa lahat ng serbisyong inaalok ng Mapandan ayon sa iyong kailangan, hindi ayon sa opisina na humahawak nito. View full transparency dashboard → Ikatlong Klase na Bayan · Rehiyon I Isang bayang nagtatanim ng palay sa Ikatlong Distrito ng Pangasinan Matatagpuan ang Mapandan sa Ikatlong Kongresyonal na Distrito ng Pangasinan, na nasa hangganan ng San Jacinto sa hilaga, Mangaldan sa hilagang-kanluran, Manaoag sa silangan, at Santa Barbara sa timog. May lawak itong 32.92 kilometro kuwadrado, at halos tatlong-kapat ng lupain nito ay ginagamit sa agrikultura—pangunahing palay, kasama ang mais, paghahayupan, at mga pana-panahong gulay. Isinasagawa ng pamahalaang bayan ang mga programa nito sa ilalim ng tagline na “Kaakibat niyo ang Aktibo at Responsableng Liderato.” 01 Itinatag noong Dis. 28, 1887 Hiwalay sa Mangaldan bilang isang independenteng pueblo sa ilalim ni Heneral Gobernador Emilio Bravo, pinamunuan ng sampung lokal na lider kabilang si Antonio Morales, Sabino Prado, at Andres Bongato. 02 Muling itinatag noong 1909 Isang matinding epidemya ang nagpilit sa pansamantalang pagsasama muli sa Mangaldan. Ang buong kasarinlan ay naibalik sa pamamagitan ng Executive Order Blg. 10 ni Heneral Gobernador James F. Smith. 03 Puso ng Agrikultura Humigit-kumulang 75% ng 32.92 km² ng munisipalidad ay inilaan para sa produksiyong agrikultural, hayop, at pag-aalaga ng manok. title: Pahayag sa Aksesibilidad — BetterMapandan.org
description: Pangako at mga pamantayan sa aksesibilidad para sa Better Mapandan civic transparency portal.
body: Accessibility Statement Accessibility Statement Pangako naming gawing accessible sa lahat ng residente ang impormasyon ng pamahalaan. Our commitment Better Mapandan is committed to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities. We continually improve the user experience for everyone and apply the relevant accessibility standards. Conformance Status We aim to conform to the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 at the AA level. These guidelines explain how to make web content more accessible for people with disabilities. Measures Taken We have implemented the following accessibility features across the site: Semantic HTML structure Skip-to-content navigation link Visible focus indicators Sufficient color contrast (4.5:1 minimum) Keyboard-accessible navigation Screen-reader-friendly labels Descriptive link text Proper heading hierarchy Accessibility features Keyboard Navigation All interactive elements are accessible via keyboard. Use Tab to move between elements, Enter to activate links and buttons, and Escape to close overlays. Screen Readers The site uses semantic HTML, ARIA labels, and proper heading hierarchy to ensure screen readers can navigate the content effectively. Color & Contrast All text meets WCAG AA contrast requirements. Information is never conveyed through color alone — icons, labels, and text are always provided alongside color coding. Text Resizing The site uses relative units (rem, em) for text sizing. Users can resize text up to 200% without loss of content or functionality. Forms All form inputs are associated with labels. Error messages are descriptive and programmatically associated with the relevant input fields. Tables Data tables include proper header associations ( <th scope> ), captions where appropriate, and are responsive on mobile devices. Known limitations We are aware of the following accessibility limitations and are working to address them: PDF documents: Some linked government documents (COA reports, provincial issuances) may not be fully accessible. We provide HTML summaries where possible. Interactive maps: The Leaflet map is navigable via keyboard but may present challenges for screen reader users. We provide alternative text descriptions and a data table fallback. Third-party content: Embedded content from external government websites may not meet the same accessibility standards. Feedback We welcome your feedback on the accessibility of Better Mapandan. If you encounter accessibility barriers, please let us know: Report an Issue Use our reporting form to describe the accessibility issue, the page URL, and your browser/device information. Report accessibility issue → GitHub Issues Developers can file accessibility issues directly on our GitHub repository. Open GitHub issue →

No. Ang Better Mapandan ay isang independent na civic transparency portal. Ito ay hindi opisyal na website ng pamahalaan at hindi kaakibat, ineendorso, o pinapatakbo ng Munisipalidad ng Mapandan o ng anumang ahensiya ng pamahalaan. For official information, visit mapandan.gov.ph . How is this project funded? Better Mapandan is entirely volunteer-run and uses no government funding. The cost to the people of Mapandan is ₱0. Hosting and domain costs are covered by the BetterGov.ph initiative. Where does the data come from? All data is compiled from publicly available government sources: COA audit reports, PSA census data, DILG Full Disclosure filings , BLGF treasury data, provincial issuances, and municipal announcements. Every source is attributed on the page where the data appears. How do I report incorrect information? Visit our Report Incorrect Information page. Provide the page URL, the specific error, and the correct information if known. Our volunteers will review and update the data. Services Government services How do I get a birth certificate? Visit the Municipal Civil Registrar (MCR) at the 1st Floor, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion. Bring a valid ID and the required fee. Processing time is typically 3–5 working days. See the full requirements on the Birth Certificate service page . How do I apply for a business permit? Visit the Municipal Treasurer's Office (MTO) with your DTI/SEC registration, barangay clearance, and other required documents. New permits are processed in 3–5 working days. See the Business Permit service page for full details. How do I get a building permit? Apply through the Municipal Engineering Office (MEO). Building permits require a zoning clearance, architectural plans, and structural plans. Processing takes 10–15 working days. See the Building Permit service page . How do I request a barangay clearance? Visit your barangay hall with a valid ID. Barangay clearances are typically issued the same day. This is often a prerequisite for other government transactions. Data & Transparency Data questions What does "Placeholder" mean on data? Some data is marked as "Placeholder" when the exact figure is not yet available from official sources. We use reasonable estimates based on available data and clearly mark these so residents know the difference between verified and estimated figures. How often is the data updated? Each data section includes a "Last updated" timestamp. Major updates happen when new COA audit reports, PSA census data, or municipal financial disclosures become available. The site is continuously improved by volunteers. Can I download the data? Yes. The Statistics page includes CSV download options for chart data. The Transparency page provides links to source documents. All data is publicly available and free to reuse under open data principles. How can I verify the data myself? Every data section includes a source attribution and, where available, a link to the original document. You can cross-reference with official sources like the COA website, PSA, or the municipal government directly. Contact Still have questions? For government services Contact the relevant office directly. See the Government Directory for phone numbers and email addresses. For this website Report issues, suggest improvements, or contribute on GitHub . For data corrections, use the Report Incorrect Information form.

title: Patakaran sa Privacy — BetterMapandan.org
description: Patakaran sa privacy para sa Better Mapandan civic transparency portal.
body: Privacy Policy Privacy Policy Kung paano namin pinangangasiwaan ang datos sa Better Mapandan civic transparency portal. Overview Ang Better Mapandan ay isang independent na civic transparency portal. Ito ay hindi opisyal na website ng pamahalaan at hindi kaakibat, ineendorso, o pinapatakbo ng Munisipalidad ng Mapandan o ng anumang ahensiya ng pamahalaan. We collect minimal data and are committed to protecting your privacy. Information We Collect Automatically collected: When you visit Better Mapandan, our hosting provider (GitHub Pages) may collect standard web server logs including your IP address, browser type, referring URL, and pages visited. This is standard server operation and is not used to identify individual visitors. Search queries: The search functionality runs entirely in your browser. Your search queries are never sent to a server or stored. Language preference: If you use the language switcher (when available), your preference is stored locally in your browser and is never transmitted to us. How We Use Information We do not use, sell, or share personal information. Server logs are used only for maintaining the website and understanding usage patterns in aggregate. Cookies Better Mapandan does not use cookies. The language preference is stored using localStorage , which is a browser-only storage mechanism and is not transmitted to any server. Third-Party Services The site loads the following external resources: Google Fonts (fonts.googleapis.com) — for font loading Open-Meteo API (open-meteo.com) — for weather data (loaded only on the homepage) Leaflet / OpenStreetMap — for the interactive map (loaded only on the homepage) These services have their own privacy policies. We do not share any personal data with them. Data Sources All government data presented on this site is compiled from publicly available official sources. This data is already public and is presented here for informational purposes. Changes to This Policy This privacy policy may be updated from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page with an updated date. Contact For privacy-related inquiries, please open an issue on our GitHub repository or use the report form .

title: Agriculture Subsidy
body: Agrikultura Mga Subsidiya sa Agrikultura Mag-apply para sa mga subsidiya sa agrikultura sa Mapandan. Mga binhi na may 50% diskwento, kasama ang teknikal na tulong at serbisyo sa hayop. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "Mga Subsidiya sa Agrikultura", "description": "Nag-aalok ang Municipal Agriculture Office ng mga subsidized na programa sa agrikultura kabilang ang mga binhi (hybrid at inbred na may 50% DA-RFU subsidy), pataba, kagamitan sa pagsasaka, at teknikal na tulong.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Agrikultura", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan The Municipal Agriculture Office (MAO) provides various government-subsidized agricultural programs to support local farmers and fisherfolk in Mapandan. These programs include subsidies for seeds, fertilizers, farm equipment, and technical assistance to improve agricultural productivity and livelihood. Availability of subsidies depends on national and provincial funding allocations. Mga Kinakailangan Farmer registration with the Municipal Agriculture Office Barangay certification of residency and farming activity Farm location and land area information Prosedura Register with the Municipal Agriculture Office (MAO) as a farmer or fisherfolk. Secure a barangay certification confirming your farming activity and residency. Submit your registration and requirements to the MAO. Wait for availability announcement of agricultural subsidies or programs. Receive agricultural assistance or subsidies upon program approval. Mga Detalye ng Serbisyo Responsableng Opisina: Municipal Agriculture Office (MAO) Klasipikasyon: Simple Paraan: in-person Oras ng Pagproseso: Varies (depends on availability) Bayarin: Free (government-subsidized) Saan Mag-aapply: Municipal Agriculture Office, Poblacion Makipag-ugnayan: (075) 632-1873 Pinagmulan: Mapandan Citizen’s Charter Huling Na-update: August 2025 Iulat ang maling impormasyon Na-scan na Dokumento Na-scan na pahina mula sa opisyal na Citizen’s Charter ng Mapandan na naglilista ng mga kinakailangan, bayarin, oras ng pagproseso, at responsableng kawani para sa serbisyo. title: Aics
body: Serbisyong Panlipunan — Mga ID at Sertipikasyon Tulong sa AICS Mag-apply para sa Assistance to Individual sa Crisis Situations (AICS) sa Mapandan. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "Tulong sa AICS", "description": "Ang Assistance to Individuals in Crisis Situations (AICS) ay isang programa ng pamahalaan na nagbibigay ng tulong pinansyal sa mga indibidwal at pamilya na nahaharap sa mga emergency.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Serbisyong Panlipunan — Mga ID at Sertipikasyon", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan Assistance to Individuals in Crisis Situations (AICS) is a government program that provides financial assistance to individuals and families facing emergencies such as medical crises, bereavement, or other unforeseen circumstances. In Mapandan, AICS assistance is administered by the Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office (MSWDO) in coordination with the Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD). Mga Kinakailangan Barangay certification stating the resident’s crisis situation Medical certificate (for medical-related assistance) Death certificate (for burial assistance) Valid government-issued ID Case study or social worker assessment Prosedura Secure a barangay certification from your barangay captain or kagawad. Gather all required documents (medical certificate, death certificate, etc.). Visit the MSWDO office and submit your application with supporting documents. Wait for the social worker’s assessment and case study. Receive financial assistance upon approval of your application. Mga Detalye ng Serbisyo Responsableng Opisina: Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office (MSWDO) Klasipikasyon: Simple Paraan: in-person Oras ng Pagproseso: 1–3 working days Bayarin: Free Saan Mag-aapply: MSWDO Office, Municipal Building, Poblacion Makipag-ugnayan: (075) 632-1751 / 0930-641-3934 Pinagmulan: Mapandan Citizen’s Charter Huling Na-update: August 2025 Iulat ang maling impormasyon Na-scan na Dokumento Na-scan na pahina mula sa opisyal na Citizen’s Charter ng Mapandan na naglilista ng mga kinakailangan, bayarin, oras ng pagproseso, at responsableng kawani para sa serbisyo. Citizens Charter document: aics.jpg Mga Kaugnay na Serbisyo No related services available. Nakatulong ba ang impormasyong ito? Oo Hindi Salamat sa iyong puna!

title: Birth Certificate
body: Civil Registry at mga Vital Record Certipiko ng Kapanganakan Humiling ng birth certificate mula sa Mapandan MCR. Standard ₱115, late registration ₱315–₱1,015. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "Certipiko ng Kapanganakan", "description": "Ang birth certificate ay isang vital record na inilalabas ng Municipal Civil Registrar. Saklaw ang standard registration (₱115), registration ng mga magulang na hindi kasal (₱215), hospital registration (₱100), at late registration (₱315–₱1,015).", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Civil Registry at mga Vital Record", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan A birth certificate is a vital record that serves as proof of identity, age, and Filipino citizenship. The Municipal Civil Registrar (MCR) of Mapandan issues certified copies of locally registered birth certificates. This document is required for school enrollment, passport application, employment, and other legal purposes. Mga Kinakailangan Valid government-issued ID of the requesting party PSA copy of the birth certificate (if available, for verification) Barangay certification of residency (for the person named on the certificate) Affidavit of two disinterested persons (required for delayed registration only) Prosedura Visit the Municipal Civil Registrar’s Office and present valid identification. Fill out the request form and provide the necessary supporting documents. Pay the certification fee at the Municipal Treasurer’s Office. Receive the certified birth certificate upon release. Mga Detalye ng Serbisyo Responsableng Opisina: Municipal Civil Registrar (MCR) Klasipikasyon: Simple Paraan: in-person Oras ng Pagproseso: 10 minutes (standard) to 10+ days (late registration) Bayarin: ₱115 (standard) / ₱215 (unmarried) / ₱100 (hospital) / ₱315–₱1,015 (late registration) Saan Mag-aapply: Municipal Civil Registrar’s Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion Makipag-ugnayan: (075) 633-2487 / 0912-115-5000 Pinagmulan: Mapandan Citizen’s Charter Huling Na-update: August 2025 Iulat ang maling impormasyon Na-scan na Dokumento Na-scan na pahina mula sa opisyal na Citizen’s Charter ng Mapandan na naglilista ng mga kinakailangan, bayarin, oras ng pagproseso, at responsableng kawani para sa serbisyo. title: Building Permit
body: Gusali, Engineering, at Zoning Building Permit Kumuha ng building permit mula sa Mapandan MEO. Simple: 3 araw, Complex: 7 araw, Highly Technical: 20 araw ayon sa RA 11032. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "Building Permit", "description": "Ang building permit ay kinakailangan sa ilalim ng National Building Code (PD 1096) at RA 11032. Oras ng pagproseso: Simple — 3 working days, Complex — 7 working days, Highly Technical — 20 working days.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Gusali, Engineering, at Zoning", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan A building permit is a legal requirement under the National Building Code of the Philippines (PD 1096) for any construction, renovation, alteration, or demolition of a building or structure. The Municipal Engineering Office (MEO) of Mapandan reviews and issues building permits after ensuring compliance with safety standards, zoning, and structural requirements. Mga Kinakailangan Plans duly signed & sealed by licensed professionals Certified true copy of Tax Declaration (from Assessor Office) Xerox copy of land title (from Register of Deeds) Community Tax Certificate (from Treasury Office) Latest Tax receipts (from Treasury Office) Electrical & Sanitary permit (from Municipal Health Office) Confirmation of adjoining lot owners Certification from Barangay Captain Application for locational clearance (from Zoning Office) 2 Affidavits (from Notary Public) Affidavit of consent if not lot owner (from Notary Public) Fire Safety clearance (from BFP Office) Affidavit of adjoining lot owners Prosedura Obtain a zoning clearance from the MPDC / Zoning Office. Prepare architectural and structural plans signed by licensed professionals. Submit all documents to the Municipal Engineering Office (MEO) for review. Pay the building permit fees at the Municipal Treasurer’s Office. Receive the approved building permit after technical evaluation. Mga Detalye ng Serbisyo Responsableng Opisina: Municipal Engineering Office (MEO) Klasipikasyon: Highly Technical Paraan: in-person Oras ng Pagproseso: 3 working days (Simple) / 7 working days (Complex) / 20 working days (Highly Technical) per RA 11032 Bayarin: Based on project cost (schedule per National Building Code) Saan Mag-aapply: Municipal Engineering Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion Makipag-ugnayan: (075) 636-9382 / 0918-962-7423 Pinagmulan: Mapandan Citizen’s Charter Huling Na-update: August 2025 Iulat ang maling impormasyon Na-scan na Dokumento Na-scan na pahina mula sa opisyal na Citizen’s Charter ng Mapandan na naglilista ng mga kinakailangan, bayarin, oras ng pagproseso, at responsableng kawani para sa serbisyo. title: Business Permit
body: Pagpapasyal at Lisensya ng Negosyo Bagong Business Permit Mag-apply para sa bagong business permit sa BPLO sa Mapandan. Kabilang ang endorsement sa Engineering, MPDC, RHU, at BFP. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "Bagong Business Permit", "description": "Ang business permit ay kinakailangan para sa lahat ng indibidwal o entity na nagpaplanong mag-operate ng negosyo sa loob ng Bayan ng Mapandan.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Pagpapasyal at Lisensya ng Negosyo", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan A business permit is required for all individuals or entities intending to operate a commercial business within the Municipality of Mapandan. This permit is issued after compliance with documentary and safety requirements and upon payment of applicable fees. Mga Kinakailangan Filled up UNIFIED Form / Community Tax Certificate (from BPLO/Treasury Office) DTI/SEC/CDA Registration (from DTI/SEC/CDA Office or Online Application) BIR COR, if available (from RDO Calasiao) Barangay Clearance (System Integrated) Prosedura Fill up the UNIFIED form and submit necessary requirements for verification (10 min). BPLO encodes data into the e-BPLS System. BPLO endorses applicant to various offices: Engineering (Occupancy Certificate), MPDC (Zoning Certificate), RHU (Health Certificate & Sanitary Permit), BFP (Fire Safety Inspection Certificate) (44 min). Pay fees and charges at the Treasury Office. Proceed to the Mayor's Office for issuance of Business Permit. Claim business plate and sticker at the Treasury Office (10 min). Mga Detalye ng Serbisyo Responsableng Opisina: Business Permit and Licensing Office (BPLO) Klasipikasyon: Simple Paraan: in-person Oras ng Pagproseso: ~1 hour (10 min encoding + 44 min endorsement + 10 min pay & claim) Bayarin: Mayor's Permit (₱500–₱1,000) + Business Plate & Sticker (₱250) + Weights & Measure (₱100–200) + Storage Fee (₱550) + Garbage Fee (₱800–₱1,200) Saan Mag-aapply: 1st Floor, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion Makipag-ugnayan: (075) 696-0831 / 0998-577-3164 Pinagmulan: Mapandan Citizen’s Charter Huling Na-update: August 2025 Iulat ang maling impormasyon Na-scan na Dokumento Na-scan na pahina mula sa opisyal na Citizen’s Charter ng Mapandan na naglilista ng mga kinakailangan, bayarin, oras ng pagproseso, at responsableng kawani para sa serbisyo. Citizens Charter document: business-permit.jpg Mga Kaugnay na Serbisyo Pagbabago ng Business Permit Business Zoning Clearance Mayor's Clearance at Mga Sertipikasyon Nakatulong ba ang impormasyong ito? Oo Hindi Salamat sa iyong puna!

title: Business Renewal
body: Pagpapasyal at Lisensya ng Negosyo Pagbabago ng Business Permit I-renew ang iyong business permit sa BPLO sa Mapandan. Taunang renewal para sa compliance. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "Pagbabago ng Business Permit", "description": "Ang mga negosyo na nag-operate sa loob ng Mapandan ay kinakailangang mag-renew ng kanilang business permit taun-taon.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Pagpapasyal at Lisensya ng Negosyo", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan Businesses operating within Mapandan are required to renew their business permits annually. Renewal ensures that your business remains compliant with local regulations and avoids penalties for late filing. Mga Kinakailangan Filled up UNIFIED Form / Community Tax Certificate (from BPLO/Treasury Office) DTI/SEC/CDA Registration (from DTI/SEC/CDA Office or Online Application) BIR COR (from RDO Calasiao) Barangay Clearance (System Integrated) Prosedura Fill up the UNIFIED form and submit necessary requirements for verification (10 min). BPLO encodes data into the e-BPLS System. BPLO endorses applicant to Engineering, MPDC, RHU, and BFP for required certificates (44 min). Pay fees at the Treasury Office. Fees include Mayor's Permit, Business Tax (% of Gross Sales), Plate & Sticker, Weights & Measure, Storage Fee, and Garbage Fee. Proceed to the Mayor's Office for issuance of renewed Business Permit. Claim business plate and sticker at the Treasury Office. Mga Detalye ng Serbisyo Responsableng Opisina: Business Permit and Licensing Office (BPLO) Klasipikasyon: Simple Paraan: in-person Oras ng Pagproseso: ~1 hour (similar to new business permit process) Bayarin: Mayor's Permit (₱500–₱1,000) + Business Tax (% of Gross Sales) + Business Plate & Sticker (₱250) + Weights & Measure (₱100–200) + Storage Fee (₱550) + Garbage Fee (₱800–₱1,200) Saan Mag-aapply: 1st Floor, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion Makipag-ugnayan: (075) 696-0831 / 0998-577-3164 Pinagmulan: Mapandan Citizen’s Charter Huling Na-update: August 2025 Iulat ang maling impormasyon Na-scan na Dokumento Na-scan na pahina mula sa opisyal na Citizen’s Charter ng Mapandan na naglilista ng mga kinakailangan, bayarin, oras ng pagproseso, at responsableng kawani para sa serbisyo. Citizens Charter document: business-renewal.jpg Mga Kaugnay na Serbisyo Bagong Business Permit Business Zoning Clearance Nakatulong ba ang impormasyong ito? Oo Hindi Salamat sa iyong puna!

title: Cedula
body: Real Property at Revenue Cedula / Community Tax Certificate Kumuha ng iyong Community Tax Certificate (cedula) sa Mapandan. Individual: ₱5 + ₱1/₱1k; Juridical: ₱500 + ₱2/₱5k. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "Cedula / Community Tax Certificate", "description": "Ang Community Tax Certificate (cedula) ay kinakailangan para sa iba't ibang transaksyon sa pamahalaan.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Real Property at Revenue", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan The Community Tax Certificate (cedula) is computed as follows: Individual — ₱5.00 basic + ₱1.00 for every ₱1,000 gross income from business, profession, or property, but in no case shall exceed ₱5,000.00. Juridical — ₱500.00 basic + ₱2.00 for every ₱5,000 gross income from business or worth of real property, but in no case shall exceed ₱10,000.00. Interest of 24% per annum shall be imposed on individual or juridical securing their CTC from March 1 up to the end of the year. Mga Kinakailangan Old Community Tax Certificate (if available) Proof of income (if available) Prosedura Go to Counters 1 and 2 and fill up the basic data form (15 min). Pay the required fees (3 min). Receive community tax certificate. Staff records in general collection system (2 min). title: Land Transfer
body: Real Property at Revenue Paglilipat ng Ownership ng Lupa Maglipat ng ownership ng lupa sa Mapandan sa Assessor's Office. ₱150 recording fee, 30 minuto para sa Assessor processing. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "Paglilipat ng Ownership ng Lupa", "description": "Ang paglilipat ng ownership ng lupa ay legal na proseso ng paglilipat ng mga karapatan sa ari-arian mula sa isang may-ari patungo sa isa pa.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Real Property at Revenue", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan Transfer of land ownership is the legal process of transferring property rights from one owner to another. The Municipal Assessor's Office (MASSO) records the transfer and updates the Tax Declaration under the new owner's name. The client first secures a tax clearance from the Treasury Office, then submits the transfer documents to the Assessor's Office. The Assessor records the transaction, cancels the old Tax Declaration, and issues a new one. Fee: ₱150 for recording. Mga Kinakailangan Deed of Sale, Deed of Donation, or other proof of transfer Tax Clearance from the Municipal Treasurer's Office Certified True Copy of Tax Declaration (from Assessor's Office) Valid Government-issued ID of the new owner BIR Certificate of Registration (if applicable) Prosedura Secure a Tax Clearance from the Municipal Treasurer's Office. Obtain a Certified True Copy of the Tax Declaration from the Assessor's Office. Submit all required documents to the Assessor's Office. Assessor reviews and records the transfer (15 min). Assessor cancels the old Tax Declaration and prepares the new one (10 min). Pay ₱150 recording fee at the Treasury Office. Claim the new Tax Declaration under the new owner's name (5 min). Mga Detalye ng Serbisyo Responsableng Opisina: Municipal Assessor's Office (MASSO) Klasipikasyon: Complex Paraan: in-person Oras ng Pagproseso: 30 minutes (Assessor recording); full transfer may take 15–30 working days Bayarin: ₱150 (recording fee at Assessor's Office) Saan Mag-aapply: Municipal Assessor's Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion Makipag-ugnayan: (075) 633-2653 / 0945-114-2515 Pinagmulan: Mapandan Citizen's Charter Huling Na-update: August 2025 Iulat ang maling impormasyon Na-scan na Dokumento Na-scan na pahina mula sa opisyal na Citizen’s Charter ng Mapandan na naglilista ng mga kinakailangan, bayarin, oras ng pagproseso, at responsableng kawani para sa serbisyo. title: Name Correction
body: Civil Registry at mga Vital Record Pagwawasto ng Pangalan (RA 9048) Iwasto ang iyong birth certificate sa ilalim ng RA 9048. ₱3,000 para sa pagbabago ng pangalan, ₱1,000 para sa clerical error. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "Pagwawasto ng Pangalan (RA 9048)", "description": "Ang RA 9048 ay nagpapahintulot sa pagwawasto ng mga clerical o typographical error.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Civil Registry at mga Vital Record", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan Republic Act No. 9048 authorizes the city or municipal civil registrar to correct clerical or typographical errors in civil registry entries without the need for a judicial order. This covers corrections in first names, nicknames, or minor spelling errors. This process does not apply to changes in gender, date of birth, or other substantive entries. Mga Kinakailangan Proof of Publication (from PSA) Certificate of Live Birth (from PSA) NBI Clearance Police Clearance (from PNP) Certificate of Employment (if employed) / Affidavit of non-employment Marriage Certificate, Medical records, SSS records, land title, baptismal certificate Prosedura Visit the Municipal Civil Registrar’s Office and submit all required documents. File the petition for correction of clerical error. Pay the required fees at the Municipal Treasurer’s Office. Wait for the publication period to be completed. After publication and verification, claim the corrected birth certificate from the MCR. Mga Detalye ng Serbisyo Responsableng Opisina: Municipal Civil Registrar (MCR) Klasipikasyon: Complex Paraan: in-person Oras ng Pagproseso: 10-day posting + 5 days MCR decision + 2–3 months PSA processing Bayarin: ₱3,000 (change of first name) / ₱1,000 (correction of clerical error) Saan Mag-aapply: Municipal Civil Registrar’s Office, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion Makipag-ugnayan: (075) 633-2487 / 0912-115-5000 Pinagmulan: Mapandan Citizen’s Charter Huling Na-update: August 2025 Iulat ang maling impormasyon Na-scan na Dokumento Na-scan na pahina mula sa opisyal na Citizen’s Charter ng Mapandan na naglilista ng mga kinakailangan, bayarin, oras ng pagproseso, at responsableng kawani para sa serbisyo. title: Rpt Payment
body: Real Property at Revenue Bayad sa Real Property Tax Magbayad ng iyong real property tax sa Mapandan. Basic 1% + SEF 1% ng assessed value. 10%–20% diskwento para sa prompt/advance payment. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "Bayad sa Real Property Tax", "description": "Ang real property tax (RPT) ay taunang buwis sa assessed value ng lupa, mga gusali, at mga pagpapabuti.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Real Property at Revenue", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan Real property tax (RPT) is an annual tax on the assessed value of land, buildings, and improvements within Mapandan. Computation: Basic Tax = 1% of Assessed Value + Special Education Tax (SEF) = 1% of Assessed Value. Discounts: 10% for prompt payment, 20% for advance payment. Interest on unpaid real property tax: 2% per month but not to exceed 72%. Payment is processed at Counters 4-9 of the Treasury Office. Mga Kinakailangan Real Property Tax bill (from Assessor's Office) Previous Tax receipt (if available) Prosedura Go to Counters 4 to 9 and request computation of real property tax. Staff computes the real property tax due (20 min). Pay the required fees (5 min). Receive the official receipt. Staff records in general collection system (5 min). Mga Detalye ng Serbisyo Responsableng Opisina: Municipal Treasury Office (MTO) Klasipikasyon: Simple Paraan: in-person Oras ng Pagproseso: 30 minutes (20 min computation + 5 min payment + 5 min recording) Bayarin: Basic Tax (1% of AV) + SEF (1% of AV); 10% prompt payment discount; 20% advance payment discount Saan Mag-aapply: 1st Floor, Main Municipal Building, Poblacion Makipag-ugnayan: (075) 696-0831 / 0998-577-3164 Pinagmulan: Mapandan Citizen’s Charter / Provincial Ordinance No. 253-2020 Huling Na-update: August 2025 Iulat ang maling impormasyon Na-scan na Dokumento Na-scan na pahina mula sa opisyal na Citizen’s Charter ng Mapandan na naglilista ng mga kinakailangan, bayarin, oras ng pagproseso, at responsableng kawani para sa serbisyo. title: Sanitary Permit
body: Mga Serbisyong Pangkalusugan Sanitary Permit Kumuha ng sanitary permit, health certificate, o medical certificate sa Mapandan RHU. 53 minuto ang oras ng pagproseso. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "Sanitary Permit", "description": "Ang sanitary permit ay kinakailangan para sa lahat ng negosyo na humawak ng pagkain, inumin, o iba pang consumable na produkto.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Mga Serbisyong Pangkalusugan", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan A sanitary permit is required for all businesses that handle food, beverages, or other consumable products to ensure compliance with health and sanitation standards. The permit is issued by the Municipal Health Office (MHO) after an inspection of the business premises to verify that health and safety regulations are met. Mga Kinakailangan Valid ID (government issued, employment, school, barangay certification) Laboratory Tests: CBC, urinalysis, fecalysis, sputum exam, Hepatitis B (from RHU Primary Laboratory) Chest X-Ray, PA (from government or private diagnostic facility) Prosedura Present official receipt from the Treasury Office. Laboratory examination of urine, feces, sputum is conducted by Medical Technologist (30 min). Refer to other laboratories for X-ray if needed (2 min). Refer result to MHO for interpretation (10 min). MHO does physical examination and interprets result (5 min). MHO prescribes medicines if needed (2 min). MHO signs the certification (2 min). List down certificate number on logbook and release certification (2 min). Mga Detalye ng Serbisyo Responsableng Opisina: Rural Health Unit (RHU) Klasipikasyon: Simple Paraan: in-person Oras ng Pagproseso: 53 minutes per client Bayarin: ₱130 (laboratory tests) Saan Mag-aapply: Municipal Health Office, Poblacion Makipag-ugnayan: (075) 632-1874 Pinagmulan: Mapandan Citizen’s Charter Huling Na-update: August 2025 Iulat ang maling impormasyon Na-scan na Dokumento Na-scan na pahina mula sa opisyal na Citizen’s Charter ng Mapandan na naglilista ng mga kinakailangan, bayarin, oras ng pagproseso, at responsableng kawani para sa serbisyo. title: Senior Pwd Id
body: Serbisyong Panlipunan — Mga ID at Sertipikasyon Senior Citizen / PWD ID Mag-apply para sa Senior Citizen o Persons with Disabilities (PWD) ID sa Mapandan. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "Senior Citizen / PWD ID", "description": "Ang Senior Citizen ID at Persons with Disabilities (PWD) ID ay mga ID na inilalabas ng pamahalaan na nagbibigay ng mga benepisyo at pribilehiyo sa mga tagadala.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Serbisyong Panlipunan — Mga ID at Sertipikasyon", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan The Senior Citizen ID and Persons with Disabilities (PWD) ID are government-issued identification cards that provide holders with benefits and privileges under the law. Senior Citizens (60 years old and above) and PWDs are entitled to discounts, tax exemptions, and other benefits as mandated by RA 9994 (Senior Citizens Act) and RA 7277 (Magna Carta for Disabled Persons). The IDs are processed through the MSWDO and MCR in coordination with the national implementing agencies. Mga Kinakailangan Birth certificate or PSA-issued document as proof of age (for Senior Citizens) Barangay certification of residency Two (2) pieces of 2x2 ID photos Medical certificate (for PWD applicants, indicating the nature of disability) Prosedura Secure a barangay certification of residency from your barangay office. For PWD applicants, obtain a medical certificate indicating the nature and severity of the disability. Submit all required documents to the MSWDO or MCR office. Wait for verification and processing of your application. Receive your Senior Citizen or PWD ID upon approval. body: Pagpapasyal at Lisensya ng Negosyo Special Event Permit Kumuha ng permit para sa mga espesyal na kaganapan tulad ng mga festival, konsert, fair, at iba pang pampublikong pagtitipon sa Mapandan. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "Special Event Permit", "description": "Ang special event permit ay kinakailangan para sa mga indibidwal o organisasyon na nagpaplanong maghos ng mga pampublikong kaganapan sa loob ng Mapandan.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Pagpapasyal at Lisensya ng Negosyo", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan A special event permit is required for individuals or organizations planning to hold public events within Mapandan. title: Tax Declaration
body: Real Property at Revenue Kopya ng Tax Declaration Humiling ng kopya ng iyong tax declaration mula sa Municipal Assessor's Office sa Mapandan. ₱100 bawat certified true copy, 15 minuto ang pagproseso. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "Kopya ng Tax Declaration", "description": "Ang tax declaration ay opisyal na dokumento na nagpapakita ng assessed value ng iyong real property para sa layunin ng buwis.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Real Property at Revenue", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan A tax declaration is an official document that shows the assessed value of your real property for taxation purposes. The Municipal Assessor's Office (MASSO) of Mapandan issues certified true copies of Tax Declarations upon request. This document is required for property sales, loans, insurance applications, tax payments, and other legal transactions. The client submits a written request with property details and the Assessor's Office locates the record, prepares the certified true copy, and releases it upon payment. Mga Kinakailangan Written request stating the property location (lot number, block, street, barangay) Valid Government-issued ID Prosedura Submit a written request with property details and valid ID to the Assessor's Office. title: Certificate Of Indigency
body: Serbisyong Panlipunan — Mga ID at Sertipikasyon Certipiko ng Indigency Kumuha ng Certificate of Indigency mula sa MSWDO para sa mga diskwento sa ospital, tulong sa legal, mga scholarship, at iba pang serbisyong panlipunan. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "Certipiko ng Indigency", "description": "Ang Certificate of Indigency ay inilalabas sa mga indigent na pamilya na sertipikado ng Barangay Captain.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Serbisyong Panlipunan — Mga ID at Sertipikasyon", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan The Certificate of Indigency is issued by the MSWDO to indigent families certified by the Barangay Captain. This document is required to avail of various services including hospital discounts, legal assistance from the Public Attorney's Office (PAO), scholarship assistance for college education, and other social welfare programs. The MSWDO conducts an interview and assessment to verify the client's eligibility before issuing the certificate. Mga Kinakailangan Barangay Certificate of Indigency Medical Certificate (if hospitalized) Police report / Police blotter / RTC/MTC report (if applicable) Report Card Form 138 / Recommendation (if for students) Birth Certificate (PSA/MCR) Prosedura Register at the MSWD Office. body: Serbisyong Panlipunan — Mga ID at Sertipikasyon Solo Parent ID Mag-apply para sa Solo Parent ID sa Mapandan. Alamin ang mga kinakailangan, eligibility, at proseso ng assessment sa MSWDO. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "Solo Parent ID", "description": "Ang Solo Parent ID ay inilalabas sa mga solo parent ayon sa RA 8972 (Solo Parents' Welfare Act of 2000).", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Serbisyong Panlipunan — Mga ID at Sertipikasyon", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan The Solo Parent ID is issued by the MSWDO to qualifying solo parents as mandated by RA 8972 (Solo Parents' Welfare Act of 2000). Holders are entitled to benefits including flexible work arrangements, educational assistance for children, and health care privileges. body: Serbisyong Panlipunan — Mga ID at Sertipikasyon PWD Assistive Devices Mag-apply para sa mga assistive device mula sa MSWDO para sa mga PWD sa Mapandan. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "PWD Assistive Devices", "description": "Nag-aalok ang MSWDO ng mga assistive device para sa mga Persons with Disabilities (PWD).", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Serbisyong Panlipunan — Mga ID at Sertipikasyon", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan The MSWDO provides assistive devices such as crutches, wheelchairs, prosthesis, and other gadgets to Persons with Disabilities (PWDs) to help them integrate into the mainstream of community life. The service covers orthopedically handicapped, visually impaired, and immobile individuals aged 0–59 years old. The MSWDO coordinates with PSWDO and DSWD Field Office I for funding and procurement of devices. Mga Kinakailangan Barangay Certificate of Indigency Medical Certificate with doctor's recommendation for assistive device Whole body picture Prosedura Apply at the MSWDO. A family member may represent the client. Staff will interview and gather relevant information from the client or family member. Submit Barangay Certificate, Medical Certificate, and whole body picture. MSWDO conducts follow-up, home visit, and assesses eligibility and device needs. MSWDO prepares and submits documents to PSWDO/DSWD FO1 for funding and purchase. Receive the assistive device (crutches, wheelchair, prosthesis, etc.) upon availability. body: Serbisyong Panlipunan — Mga ID at Sertipikasyon OSCA Death Aid Benefits Mag-apply para sa death aid benefit mula sa OSCA para sa pamilya ng namatay na senior citizen sa Mapandan. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "OSCA Death Aid Benefits", "description": "Ang death aid ay ibinibigay sa pamilya ng namatay na senior citizen.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Serbisyong Panlipunan — Mga ID at Sertipikasyon", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan The OSCA Death Aid Benefits provide financial assistance to families of deceased Senior Citizens. The benefit is processed through the MSWDO upon submission of the deceased's original death certificate, two photocopies of the OSCA ID, and surrender of the OSCA ID. The MSWDO prepares the application and submits reports to the Municipal Budget Office for fund allocation. Mga Kinakailangan Certificate of Indigency Death Certificate (original copy) OSCA ID (original + two photocopies) Prosedura Register at the MSWDO. Staff will conduct intake interview and assess eligibility. Submit the deceased's original Death Certificate, two photocopies of OSCA ID, and surrender the OSCA ID. MSWDO prepares the Application Form and Certificate of Eligibility. MSWDO submits report with attached documents to the Municipal Budget Office for fund allocation. Follow up with the MSWDO for the status of financial assistance. Receive the OSCA financial assistance at the Municipal Treasury Office. body: Tulong Panlipunan at Proteksyon Social Case Study Report Humiling ng social case study report mula sa MSWDO para sa mga kaso ng child welfare at social welfare. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "Social Case Study Report", "description": "Ang social case study report ay inihahanda ng MSWDO para sa mga kaso ng child welfare, domestic violence, at iba pang social welfare concerns.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Tulong Panlipunan at Proteksyon", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan A Social Case Study Report is issued to clients who need to avail of assistance from PCSO, other government hospitals, institutions, NGOs, DSWD, and various foundations. The report is prepared by MSWDO social workers after a thorough assessment that includes an initial interview, home visit, and evaluation of the client's situation. The report serves as a supporting document for various forms of assistance. body: Tulong Panlipunan at Proteksyon Pre-Marriage Counseling Kumuha ng pre-marriage counseling mula sa MSWDO bago ang iyong kasal sa Mapandan. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "Pre-Marriage Counseling", "description": "Ang pre-marriage counseling ay ibinibigay ng MSWDO sa mga mag-asawa na magpapakasal.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Tulong Panlipunan at Proteksyon", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan The MSWDO provides pre-marriage counseling to would-be couples as required before obtaining a marriage license. The counseling covers family planning, rights and responsibilities of marriage, and strengthening family solidarity. The service is mandated by law and the certificate issued is a prerequisite for marriage license application. Would-be couples, couples with marital problems, couples of reproductive age, and solo parents may avail of this service. Mga Kinakailangan Personal Data Form Marriage Counselling Services Form Prosedura Apply at the MSWDO. Staff will refer you to the Population Office. title: Disaster Relief
body: Tulong Panlipunan at Proteksyon Tulong sa Disaster Relief Mag-apply para sa tulong sa disaster relief mula sa MDRRMO sa Mapandan. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "Tulong sa Disaster Relief", "description": "Nag-aalok ang MDRRMO ng mga serbisyo ng tulong sa disaster para sa mga apektadong residente.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Tulong Panlipunan at Proteksyon", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan The MSWDO provides disaster relief assistance and rehabilitation services to families affected by floods, typhoons, fires, and other calamities. The service includes verification of affected families, distribution of relief goods through the Barangay Captain with the BDCC, and financial assistance (ESA) for families whose houses are totally destroyed. The MSWDO coordinates with the LGU, PSWDO, and DSWD Field Office I. Mga Kinakailangan Master list of affected families (from Barangay Captain) Barangay certificate Certificate of Indigency Prosedura Report to the Barangay Captain the extent of damage. The Captain validates and forwards the list to MSWDO. MSWDO attends MDDC meeting conducted by the Local Chief Executive. MSWDO receives list of affected families and endorses to concerned social worker. Verification and inspection team (with Engineering, PNP, DSWD) assesses the damage. MSWDO requests and lobbies for allocation of relief goods from LGU, PSWDO, DSWD FO1. Distribution of relief goods through the Barangay Captain with the BDCC. For totally destroyed houses, MSWDO prepares project proposal for ESA funding. Financial assistance (ESA) is distributed to qualified beneficiaries. MSWDO monitors and evaluates project implementation for house repair/reconstruction. title: Pre Natal
body: Mga Serbisyong Pangkalusugan Pre-Natal Consultation Kumuha ng pre-natal na konsultasyon sa RHU sa Mapandan. Libre para sa lahat ng buntis. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "Pre-Natal Consultation", "description": "Nag-aalok ang RHU ng mga pre-natal na konsultasyon para sa mga buntis na kababaihan.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Mga Serbisyong Pangkalusugan", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan The RHU provides pre-natal consultation services for antenatal women. The service includes registration in the Electronic Medical Record (EMR), OB history, vital signs, Leopold's maneuver, fetal heartbeat assessment, and fundic height measurement. Routine laboratory tests (CBC, urinalysis, HBsAg, RPR) are requested. The MHO conducts complete physical examination, interprets laboratory results, and provides health teaching on proper nutrition, prenatal care, breastfeeding, and immunization. High-risk patients are referred to higher-level facilities. Mga Kinakailangan Valid ID (government issued, employment, school, barangay certification) Medical Records, Laboratory Results, Prescription for Medicines (from previous physician, if any) Prosedura Register in the Electronic Medical Record (EMR). Health teaching on proper nutrition, prenatal care, breastfeeding, and immunization. body: Mga Serbisyong Pangkalusugan Programang Nutrition at Immunization Mga programang nutrition at immunization mula sa RHU sa Mapandan. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "Programang Nutrition at Immunization", "description": "Nag-aalok ang RHU ng mga programang nutrition at immunization.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Mga Serbisyong Pangkalusugan", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan The RHU implements the Nutrition Program for malnourished children (0–59 months and older) and the National Immunization Program (NIP) for children against vaccine-preventable diseases. The nutrition program includes assessment, deworming, feeding with nutrient-dense food, and monthly monitoring. The immunization program administers age-appropriate vaccines after reviewing the child's records and checking vital signs. Mga Kinakailangan Birth Certificate (Municipal Civil Registry) Medical Records, Vaccination Records (from hospital of birth or pediatrician) Prosedura For malnourished children (0–59 months): Barangay Nutrition Scholar assesses weight and height. Physician refers to RHU for deworming and medical intervention. Child is fed with nutrient-dense food (high carbohydrate and protein). Monthly monitoring of weight, height, and alertness. For immunization: BHW interviews child's information and reviews records. Midwife checks vital signs (weight and temperature). Midwife administers age-appropriate vaccine. Midwife advises parent on child care and expected outcome. Schedule next vaccination. body: Zoning at Planificación Electrical Zoning Clearance Kumuha ng electrical zoning clearance mula sa MPDC sa Mapandan. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "Electrical Zoning Clearance", "description": "Ang electrical zoning clearance ay kinakailangan para sa mga electrical installation.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Zoning at Planificación", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan A zoning clearance is required for electrical permits. The MPDC/Zoning Office evaluates the application, conducts land use assessment, and issues the Zoning Compliance Certificate for electrical installations. The process includes site evaluation/inspection, computation of fees, and approval by the Zoning Officer. Mga Kinakailangan Application for Zoning Permit (from MPDC) Accomplished Individual Assessment for Application of Temporary Housing Unit Form Tax Declaration of lot (from Assessor Office) Current Tax receipts (from Treasury Office) Affidavit of consent of lot owner Site development sketch indicating the ROW Affidavit of consent for Right of Way (from lot owner) Certification from Barangay Captain Prosedura Inquire at the MPDC office and secure the application form. MPDC staff conducts interview and provides forms. Accomplish forms and prepare all required documents. MPDC checks and evaluates forms and required documents. Request for site evaluation/inspection. Land use assessment conducted. Go to Zoning office for computation of fees and charges. Pay fees at the Treasury Office. Present receipts to MPDC. Submit one photocopy of all forms and documents. MPDC prepares and submits documents. Zoning Officer approves application. Client signs logbook. body: Real Property at Revenue Financial Assistance Claims Payment Mag-claim ng financial assistance payment sa Mapandan. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "Financial Assistance Claims Payment", "description": "Mga bayad para sa financial assistance claims.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Real Property at Revenue", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan Payment of financial assistance and other claims for indigent residents of Mapandan. body: Agrikultura Seed Certification Services Kumuha ng seed certification mula sa MAO sa Mapandan. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "Seed Certification Services", "description": "Mga serbisyo ng sertipikasyon ng binhi.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Agrikultura", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan The Municipal Agriculturist provides technical and extension services for seed certification. title: Demolition Permit
body: Gusali, Engineering, at Zoning Demolition Permit Kumuha ng demolition permit mula sa MEO sa Mapandan. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "Demolition Permit", "description": "Ang demolition permit ay kinakailangan para sa pag-demolish ng mga gusali.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Gusali, Engineering, at Zoning", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan A demolition permit is required before any demolition of a building or structure in Mapandan. The Municipal Engineer conducts initial assessment of the application, site inspection, and computation of fees. The permit is issued after payment and verification of all requirements. Mga Kinakailangan Application for demolition permit Approved demolition plans (if applicable) Proof of ownership or authorization from owner Prosedura Report to the Engineering Office for assessment of your application (15 min). body: Civil Registry at mga Vital Record Rehistrasyon ng Kapanganakan Mag-rehistro ng kapanganakan sa MCR sa Mapandan. { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "GovernmentService", "name": "Rehistrasyon ng Kapanganakan", "description": "Rehistrasyon ng kapanganakan sa Municipal Civil Registrar.", "provider": { "@type": "GovernmentOrganization", "name": "Municipality of Mapandan", "address": { "@type": "PostalAddress", "addressLocality": "Mapandan", "addressRegion": "Pangasinan", "addressCountry": "PH" } }, "serviceType": "Civil Registry at mga Vital Record", "areaServed": { "@type": "Place", "name": "Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines" } } Paglalarawan Registration of birth at the Municipal Civil Registrar. Covers three pathways: (1) Attending midwife/hilot reports child's birth — requires Marriage Certificate of parents and Mun. Form 102; (2) Unmarried parents — requires Community Tax Certificate; (3) Hospital administrator — requires Accomplished Mun. Form 102. Late registration requires negative PSA certification and supporting documents. Fees: Misc Fee ₱115 (standard), ₱215 (unmarried), ₱100 (hospital), ₱315–₱1,015 (late registration depending on age). Mga Kinakailangan Marriage Certificate of parents from PSA (for attending midwife/hilot registration) Community Tax Certificate from Treasury Office (for unmarried parents) Accomplished Mun. Form 102 from MCR (for hospital registration) Negative certification from PSA (for late registration) Affidavit of delayed registration (for late registration) Supporting evidence: Baptismal Certificate, School records, ITR, Insurance Policy, Medical records, Barangay certification (for late registration) Prosedura Attending midwife/hilot reports child's birth. MCR evaluates information and registers (10 min). For unmarried parents: Hospital admin or representative prepares documents (15 min). For late registration: Apply at MCR, verify from CRIS/Registry Book. If negative, submit requirements. Data typed in Certificate of Live Birth (15 min typing). MCR approves registration (after 10 days of posting for late registration). Secure copy of birth certificate. MCR releases documents (3 min). body: Sangguniang Bayan Legislative Documents A comprehensive database of municipal ordinances, resolutions, executive issuances, and fiscal data — tracing Mapandan's legislative record from its 1887 founding to the present. Ang Sangguniang Bayan — isang unicameral na lokal na lehislatibong konseho — ang nagsasagawa ng municipal legislative power, pinamumunuan ng Municipal Vice Mayor at binubuo ng mga halal na konsehal kasama ang mga ex-officio representatives mula sa Liga ng mga Barangay at Sangguniang Kabataan Federation. Mga Pinagmulan sa Kasaysayan Originally an agricultural barrio of Mangaldan referred to as balon baley ("new town"), Mapandan was first established as an independent pueblo pursuant to Direction General No. 39, Administration Civil No. 169-C, promulgated by Governor General Emilio Bravo on December 28, 1887. Following population and fiscal losses caused by an epidemic in 1905 that temporarily reverted Mapandan to Mangaldan's jurisdiction, the municipality was re-established under American civil administration through Executive Order No. 10, signed by Governor General James F. Smith in 1909.
